name: vku-field-survey
description: Offline-first VKU facility inspection PWA and Capacitor app.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:pwa && npm run cap:sync -w client
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:pwa && npm run cap:sync -w client && cd client/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
